name: Kono Oozora ni, Tsubasa o Hirogete: FLIGHT DIARY
original_name: この大空に、翼をひろげて FLIGHT DIARY
source:
This is the fandisk for Konosora, featuring a before story for the Soaring Club (after Amane's route), an after story for the Soaring Club (after Kotori's route), as well as if stories for subheroines Hotaru and Kanako. There's also some additional ecchi-focused side stories for twins Asa and Yoru, and siblings Ageha and Hotaru.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/01/01/january-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《这片天空、展翅飞翔》的Fan Disc，包含翱翔部的前日谈（天音线之后）、翱翔部的后日谈（小鸟线之后），以及副女主角萤和加奈子的if故事。还有双胞胎朝和夜、以及兄妹凤和萤的一些额外色情侧篇。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/01/01/january-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
